about: Clarence-Rockland is a city on the Ottawa River in eastern Ontario’s Prescott and Russell United Counties, east of Ottawa. Rockland is the main urban centre; Clarence Creek and other villages sit inland. Many residents commute west into Ottawa while keeping a smaller bilingual riverside character. About 27,000 people live in Clarence-Rockland.
seoSummary: Bilingual Ottawa River city east of Ottawa, with Rockland as its main urban centre.
